title: PerchSession
description: A single agent session entry saved by a Perch /perch command.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Perch entry (uuidgen, lowercase).

agent.description: The AI agent that created this session entry.

session_id.description: Native session identifier from the agent runtime.

working_dir.description: Absolute path of the working directory when /perch was invoked.

title.description: Short human-readable title (≤60 chars) describing the session.

note.description: Optional freeform note provided by the user as the /perch argument.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this entry was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent /perch update for this entry. Omitted until the first update.

resume_cmd.description: Shell command to resume this session (e.g. claude --resume <session_id>).
